meta.title: Project cognition index
meta.description: Maintains a plain-text, Git-versioned cognition map of each project (.cognition/ volumes with FRAS entries), so a session reads one index instead of re-discovering the codebase. Simplified re-implementation of the AOCI-CODE method.

cognition_overview.summary: Load the whole cognition map before working on a project; chunked delivery for large indexes, includes the database volume.

tools.cognition_scan: Report missing/orphan/stale drift and a batched authoring plan.
tools.cognition_update_entries: Validate and write FRAS entries (code/database volumes).
tools.cognition_remove_entries: Drop entries whose files/tables were deleted.
tools.cognition_search: Filter entries by tag, path, keyword, or project forward/reverse R relations.
tools.cognition_database_init: Import a .sql DDL dump as Schema Evidence and enable the database volume.
tools.cognition_verify: Re-validate every volume's entries; returns the alignment verdict.

panel: Read-only panel: inspect index status, drift, and the verify verdict
